Sir, 
Reference is invited to Pension Division letter referred above on the above subject. 
2. 
The Norms that were approved and communicated earlier cover the basic 
requirement of field offices, Head Office, Zones, PDNASS / ZTis, Zonal Vigilance Offices and 
Zonal Audit Setups. 
3. 
Furthermore, to cater to the requirement of registration of Digital Life Certificate 
(DLC) of Jeevan Praman for Pensioners through "UMANG" (Mobile Application), the new 
additional requirement of mobile devices for the field offices has been decided and the 
specification of the mobile device is enclosed herewith to capture the required information. 
4. 
The procurement should be made strictly in accordance with the provisions of GFR 
2017 and eve guidelines/ instructions issued from time to time. 
{This issues with the approval of CPFC}
